title: TestResidentAdmission_matrix assertion is tautological and cannot fail
reason: Defect is a test whose guarded check is unreachable; it stays green if the feature table is emptied. Not product code, so R/B/N do not apply.

title: Metal snapshot golden pins an unscaled-embed stream production never runs
reason: Filed as a golden hashing a computation the shipped path never runs; the product embed-scale miss is cross-referenced to B-11, not this entry (R considered).

title: Generated capability matrix depends on ambient GOINFER env vars
reason: Freshness test and -update output depend on process environment; a gate defect in test code, fixed with t.Setenv.

title: residencyBufs unset on explicit slots arm, blinding residency staleness gate
reason: Filed as a disabled gate: slots arm is dispatched and pins correctly, only the record the test reads is missing; not treated-as-default, so not R.

title: M25 EncodeSegments gate keyed on hardcoded developer-home GGUF path
reason: Gate skips on every other machine because its fixture path is hardcoded; a test/gate defect with no product-code miss.

title: 34 hardcoded developer-home model paths make tests skip elsewhere
reason: Test fixture paths hardcoded to two machines make 29% of tests skip; purely a test/gate defect.

title: No ReadTimeout or inflight cap; expensive work precedes queue gate
reason: Unbounded concurrency and slow-body pinning on pre-queue work with no limit held; rubric puts no-limit resource exhaustion in O, not B.

title: Explicit top_p 0 disables nucleus filtering instead of greedy
reason: Explicit top_p=0 falls into the sampler's TopP>0 'disabled' default; fix gives it named greedy handling plus refusal. R vs O (request validation).
path_missed: prepare top_p mapping / sampler TopP > 0 predicate

title: Omitted seed defaults to 0, making completions fully deterministic
reason: The absent case is the default itself and its chosen behaviour breaks the OpenAI contract; no unregistered value or arithmetic error, so API semantics O.

title: Context-clamped generation reports finish_reason stop instead of length
reason: finish_reason logic handles max_tokens but compares against requested, not effective, budget; fix plumbs the value rather than registering anything (R considered).

title: Forced tool_choice silently degrades to unconstrained decoding
reason: Unbuildable grammar (gemma3/gemma4 wrapper ok=false, rejected schema) under named tool_choice falls to default unconstrained path; fix is a named 400 refusal. R vs O.
option_or_family: named tool_choice with gemma3/gemma4 families or unenforceable schemas
path_missed: forced-tool grammar guard in tools.go/anthropic.go/responses.go (error discarded)

title: /v1/completions logprobs typed bool, leaks Go names, wastes compute
reason: API compatibility and request-parsing shape; no unregistered option on a dispatch path and no numeric error.

title: EAGLE speculative entry points skip ForwardCapture arch allow-list
reason: Families the capture seam rejects (DeepSeek/MLA etc.) are admitted by EAGLE entry points and panic in fuseAt; fix applies the allow-list/canBatchN guard.
option_or_family: families without capture seam (mla/DeepSeek, gemma4, qwen35, granite, nemotron, llama4, gptoss)

title: loadWeights leaks checkpoint mmap on ~40 error paths
reason: Resource leak on error paths; rubric places leaks in O.

title: Metal PrefillLast binds model-level RoPE table and window, not per-layer
reason: Prefill claims sliding-window support but binds the wrong (model-level) buffers per layer; a wrong-binding computation fixed by rebinding, not registration (R considered).

title: Metal int4 pack never checks K % 32 == 0 kernels assume
reason: Kernels hard-assume K multiple of 32 with nothing checking; fix is a decline. A shape constraint, not an option/family/state, so B not R.

title: Metal dynamic threadgroup memory never validated against device limit
reason: Threadgroup memory sized from model dims can exceed maxThreadgroupMemoryLength with no check; fix is a decline in BuildResident.

title: WebGPU single-query attention kernels assume head_dim <= 128 unchecked
reason: Kernel capacity of 128 (workgroup_size, red array) exceeded by admitted archs with no check; fix adds a decline.

title: DecodePiece applies sequence-level leading-space strip to every token
reason: Decoder knows the dummy-prefix strip but applies it at the wrong granularity, producing wrong text; nothing unregistered (O for exported-API break considered).

title: LoadJSONBytes reads tokenizer_config.json from the process CWD
reason: Self-contained bytes load is treated as the default directory-based load, so sibling lookup hits CWD; fix registers an explicit no-sibling mode. R vs O (hermeticity).
option_or_family: self-contained bytes tokenizer load (no sibling dir)

title: Qwen image preprocessing accepts unbounded input image dimensions
reason: Unbounded decoded dimensions allocate proportional memory; MaxPixels caps output only, so no input limit is held — rubric's unbounded-allocation O case.

title: WebGPU buffers leak on matmul and ForwardPatches error paths
reason: Buffer leaks on error paths; rubric places leaks in O.

title: CUDA MoE groups cap published as 32 while runtime allows 64
reason: Wrong constant only feeds the published capability matrix whose comment claims runtime parity; runtime admits correctly. Not B (no unchecked overflow); N considered.

title: CI never builds gpu- or metal-wired cmd/serve
reason: CI jobs' hand-written build lists omit wired serve for the gpu and metal tags that the cuda job covers; a gate gap, R-shaped.

title: Root go.mod drags whole GPU dependency set into pure-Go consumers
reason: Module-graph mechanics; the CI guard gap is secondary to the module-structure defect.

title: NOTICE/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES miss x/sys and aikit/gpu attributions
reason: License-attribution completeness is release mechanics; an omission rather than a false claim, so O over G.

title: No context.Context on multi-gigabyte GGUF transcodes
reason: Missing cancellation in an exported signature; API shape / breaking-change risk.

title: cuda.SpecStats and decoder.SpecStats share a name, differ in fields
reason: Exported type naming collision across modules; API shape.

title: Config() and Weights() expose mutable internals that desync caches
reason: Exported API returning mutable internal pointers; API shape, not an unregistered value or arithmetic error.
